provenance.origin: 100% project-authored seed documents (code examples with explanations, professional emails/letters, technical knowledge paragraphs, short stories, instruction/response pairs) written for this project
provenance.expansion: deterministic synthetic expansion by paragraph-order shuffling (8 variants per eligible document); every expanded document is labeled origin=synthetic_expansion and traces back to its seed
provenance.external_sources: none. No web scraping, no third-party datasets.
